bullets.title: Daily Zen.
bullets.note:
How
do you test your wifi connectivity? Typically, I have pulled up a website that
changes daily (to account for browser cache, etc.). The go-to sites used to be
news-related, but to avoid the newfound Chicken Little
panic/anxiety/depression of such places, I now test Daily Zen, which displays
a different Zen adage or story each day.**
